headline: 2 core contracts catalogued on TRON (JustswapFactory + USDT/TRX Exchange example); TRON Base58 addresses incompatible with EVM address schema; DeFiPunkd read API unavailable for TRON chain.

findings.text: D1: TronScan (tronscan.org) is not in the supported EVM block-explorer list; direct fetch of tronscan.org contract pages was not attempted as the allowlist only covers EVM explorers. Search results surfaced TronScan URLs confirming factory TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF and USDT/TRX exchange TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE but these are snippet-only sightings, not full fetches.

D2: Official API documentation at sunswap.com/docs/justswap-interfaces_en.pdf fetched successfully; lists factory contract TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF and exchange example TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE (USDT/TRX pair). No separate deployments page exists; the API doc serves as deployed_contracts_doc.

D3: SlowMist audit PDF (Aug 25, 2020) fetched in full; scope covers JustswapExchange.sol and JustswapFactory.sol by file hash only — no deployed on-chain TRON addresses appear anywhere in the 19-page report. Audit result: passed with 1 low-risk and 1 enhancement finding.

D4: No GitHub repository recorded for SUNSwap V1 in protocol.github. A search surfaced github.com/sunswapteam/sunswap2.0-contracts (V2 only) and an unofficial mirror github.com/qyvlik/tron-justswap. No official V1 broadcast/deployment artifacts found.
D5: Protocol is single-chain (TRON only). No multi-chain enumeration required.

D6: Factory TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF is a factory that spawns individual JustswapExchange contracts (one per TRC20 token). DeFiPunkd read API does not support TRON chainId; no getTokenWithId enumeration was possible. Cap notice: factory likely has hundreds of child exchange contracts; full enumeration requires TRON-native tooling.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: factory (JustswapFactory), pool/exchange (JustswapExchange per token). No owner/admin/multisig/timelock roles identified in the V1 contracts — the audit and API docs show no admin functions in the deployed contracts.

D8: All discovered addresses are TRON Base58 format (T...) and do not match the required 0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40} schema for admin_addresses[]. Addresses are recorded in evidence[] with role annotations and in unknowns[] pending schema support for TRON addresses.

rationale.verdict: Discovery walk completed across audit PDF, official API docs, and search. Two TRON-native contract addresses were confirmed from the official sunswap.com docs: JustswapFactory (TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF) and the USDT/TRX exchange example (TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE). Grade is unknown because (a) TRON Base58 addresses cannot be placed in admin_addresses[] per schema validation rules, (b) DeFiPunkd read API is unavailable for TRON, and (c) factory child enumeration was not possible without TRON-native tooling.

evidence.shows: SUNSwap website metadata: TRON-based decentralized trading protocol for automated liquidity provision; supports TRC20 token exchange; market makers earn 0.3% fees with no platform commission.

SlowMist security audit of JustSwap (now SUNSwap V1), dated Aug 25, 2020. Scope: JustswapExchange.sol (SHA1: 64c33c94f379890d580c5971ec44073cd42c7e7c) and JustswapFactory.sol (SHA1: 84d90357c979f5f81991551986033ccf6589a729). No deployed TRON addresses listed. Audit result: Passed. Two findings: low-risk liquidity removal design defect; enhancement suggestion for redundant code. Protocol confirmed to have no admin/owner/pause functions in its V1 contracts.

Official JustSwap API Documentation v1.0.0 by Just team. Section 2.1 Smart contract address table: factory contract = TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF (creates/manages trading pairs); exchange contract example (USDT/TRX) = TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE. Backend API endpoint: https://api.justswap.io/v2/allpairs. No proxy, admin, or timelock addresses listed.

unknowns: D1: TronScan (tronscan.org) not in EVM block-explorer allowlist; full on-chain name-tag search for 'SUNSwap' / 'JustSwap' on TRON was not performed. Addresses TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF and TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE appeared in search snippets referencing tronscan.org but were not fetched from the explorer directly.

D4: No official GitHub repository for SUNSwap V1 source code or deployment artifacts was found. github.com/sunswapteam/sunswap2.0-contracts covers V2 only. V1 source may be in an unlisted or archived repo.

D6: JustswapFactory TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF creates child JustswapExchange contracts per TRC20 token; DeFiPunkd read API does not support TRON chainId, so getTokenWithId enumeration was not possible. Number of pools unknown; likely hundreds. Full child enumeration requires TRON-native tooling.

D8: All discovered TRON contract addresses are Base58-encoded (T... format) and cannot be placed in admin_addresses[] which requires 0x[hex]{40} EVM format. Addresses are: factory=TXk8rQSAvPvBBNtqSoY6nCfsXWCSSpTVQF, USDT/TRX exchange=TQn9Y2khEsLJW1ChVWFMSMeRDow5KcbLSE, JST/USDT exchange=TYukBQZ2XXCcRCReAUguyXncCWNY9CEiDQ (search snippet only). Schema extension needed for TRON Base58 addresses.

D8-offchain: DeFiPunkd read API (defipunkd.com/api/contract/read) does not support TRON; all on-chain reads were impossible. grading_basis set to mixed as off-chain docs were fetched but no on-chain state was read.

protocol_metadata.about: SUNSwap V1 (originally JustSwap) is a TRON-based decentralized exchange protocol for automated liquidity provision between TRC20 tokens and TRX. Users swap TRC20 tokens via individual per-token exchange contracts, each holding a TRX/token liquidity pool using a constant-product AMM mechanism. Liquidity providers deposit TRC20 tokens and TRX to earn a share of the 0.3% swap fee, with the platform taking no commission. The JustswapFactory contract deploys one JustswapExchange contract per TRC20 token; these exchange contracts are immutable with no admin or upgrade functions.
